questions.title: Life expectancy at birth in the world
questions.hint: Life expectancy reflects deaths at every age, so a change among the young moves it most.
questions.explanation: It rose to 73.2 years in 2023, from 53.7 years in 1963.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Cigarettes sold per adult per day in the United States
questions.hint: This century brought higher tobacco taxes, indoor smoking bans, and the rise of e-cigarettes.
questions.explanation: It fell to 2.4 in 2020, from 5.7 in 2000.

source.attribution: US CDC, Office on Smoking and Health

questions.title: Median age of the population in China
questions.hint: Half the population is older than the median. It moves slowly and depends mostly on past births.
questions.explanation: It rose to 37 years in 2020, from 20 years in 1960.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Average number of children per woman in South Korea
questions.hint: Fertility tends to respond to education, urban living, contraception, and the cost of raising children.
questions.explanation: It fell to 0.8 in 2022, from 2.7 in 1980. South Korea’s fertility rate is now among the lowest in the world.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects

questions.title: Annual population growth rate in Nigeria
questions.hint: Growth depends on births minus deaths, plus migration. It can be negative.
questions.explanation: It went from 2.0% in 1960 to a high of 3.1% in 1980, then ended at 2.1% in 2020.

source.attribution: UN Population Division, World Population Prospects
